verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a dedicated 'WorkOS CLI migrations tool' for exporting Auth0 data, showing an official CLI exists, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose CLI for managing WorkOS resources or built for AI-native/agentic workflows (the AI-facing surface is instead an MCP server, not a CLI). Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI beyond migration tooling, CLI documentation/reference, and any AI-native use-case tailoring of the CLI.
